description: Sent at the end of a return session: after-idle (the NTP or LUT treatment shown once the After Inactivity threshold elapses) or an ordinary return, capturing where the user landed, what they did, and how the session ended.

form_factor.description: The form factor of the device

platform.description: The platform the app is running on

is_first_daily_occurrence.description: Whether this is the first occurrence of this event today. Only included when true.

name.description: The feature name for this event

status.description: The overall status of the operation

surface.description: Coarse landing surface when the session started: an NTP or resumed tab content (LUT)

status_reason.description: Terminal reason describing how the session ended. SUCCESS uses one of the user-action reasons (bar_used split into search_submitted / ai_prompt_submitted / url_submitted in v3.0); CANCELLED uses app_backgrounded; UNKNOWN uses app_terminated when an in-flight session is recovered after an app crash or termination.

after_idle.description: True when the session was started by an after-idle treatment; false for an ordinary return. Filtering after_idle=true reproduces the pre-v3.0 series.

landed_on.description: What the user actually landed on: the after-idle NTP, an NTP reached without the treatment, or the resumed tab's content type

time_away_ms_bucketed.description: Time the app spent in the background before this return, bucketed (lower end of bucket, in ms). Absent when there was no prior background date.

focused.description: True when the landing surface appeared with the address bar focused (keyboard up)

session_duration_ms_bucketed.description: Total time the post-idle surface was visible, from session start until the terminal action or background, bucketed (lower end of bucket, in ms). Absent when the session was orphaned (UNKNOWN / app_terminated).

time_to_first_interaction_ms_bucketed.description: Time from session start to the first user interaction with the post-idle surface (page engagement, toggle, back, or terminal action), bucketed (lower end of bucket, in ms). Absent if the session ended without any interaction.

page_engaged.description: True if the user scrolled or activated an in-page link on the post-idle surface during the session

toggle_used.description: True if the user toggled between Search and Duck.ai during the session

back_pressed.description: True if the user pressed back / cancel from the post-idle surface during the session

opening_screen_changed.description: True if the user changed the Opening Screen option from the escape hatch's settings menu during the session

close_tab_tapped.description: True if the user closed the open tab from the escape hatch's menu during the session

burn_tab_tapped.description: True if the user burned the open tab from the escape hatch's menu during the session
